label: 5. Do you think Ruru arrived where she was going?

lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 102210112 · After Cats make the world go 'round. chat 4. Ruru's become something of a sensation in the …

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Do you think Ruru arrived where she was going?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I miss her already.
I'm sure she did.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Why do those we love always leave us?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I think saying goodbye is the hardest thing in the world.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I can't stop thinking about her.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I don't think I can be in this chat anymore.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Sorry, everyone.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: It was fun while it lasted.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: I'll come by the shelter when I'm feeling better.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Sure thing. We'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Take care of yourself, Admi.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Thanks. You too.
Admi left the group chat.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I think I'll leave as well.
Biscuit left the group chat.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Wherever Ruru is, I'm sure she's happy. She's somewhere where there's no pain or sadness.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Nero, Zoo Keeper, take care of yourselves.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: If you're ever having a hard time, feel free to get in touch with me.
Leona left the group chat.
... Nero and I don't talk for a long time.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Aren't you leaving, Scoops?
I don't want to erase the memories we've created.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Me neither.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Then let's not leave.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Let's stay here and continue to treasure the memories we had with Ruru.
Let's do that.
